text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا

words.gloss_range: opening coordinator that carries the prior imperative sequence into this command
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not let the ayah open as an isolated reaction. It binds {{ar:ٱصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:iṣbir}}) to the prior command movement, so public endurance arrives as continuation from the earlier devotional and trust frame rather than as a new tactic. Even the joined recitational entry makes the command feel launched from what precedes.

topics.headline: opening connector extends the command chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command to endure begins as a continuation of the preceding imperative sequence, not as a detached reaction.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) as coordinating the imperative {{ar:ٱصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:iṣbir}}) with the surrounding command frame.

topics.headline: bound sound-entry into the imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the connector as attached entry into the command, making continuity audible as well as syntactic.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector is written and recited with the following imperative, so the form supports a connected launch.

words.gloss_range: direct command to endure hostile speech as borne pressure, with active self-restraint rather than passive inaction
words.root_gloss_range: restraint, patience, holding firm, and intensified self-binding; local Form I imperative selects commanded endurance, while heavier derived forms remain background pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:iṣbir}}) assigns restraint directly to the addressed messenger. With {{ar:عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:ʿalā mā yaqūlūna}}), their speech is treated as pressure to be borne, not as a duel to enter. The {{ar:ص ب ر}} ({{tr:ṣ-b-r}}) field makes this active self-binding; heavier family forms intensify the background of forcing the self to hold, while the local surface stays the direct Form I command. Because this command comes before {{ar:ٱهْجُرْهُمْ}} ({{tr:uhjurhum}}), withdrawal is staged after mastered endurance, and the beautiful-patience pattern (12:18; 12:83; 70:5) already leans toward the ayah's final beautiful departure.

topics.headline: second-person command makes restraint personal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience is not a general virtue label here but an enacted command placed on the addressee.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a Form I second-person masculine imperative with an implicit addressee subject.

topics.headline: root family thickens active self-restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels patience as active self-binding under pressure, while the local form remains the simple command rather than a heavier derived form.
topics.reason: The broader {{ar:ص ب ر}} ({{tr:ṣ-b-r}}) family supports restraint and intensified perseverance, but QAC identifies the local word as Form I, not the derived forms themselves.

topics.headline: speech becomes borne pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees their saying as the burden over which restraint operates, not as quoted content that controls the scene.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) govern the relative speech clause as the complement of the imperative.

topics.headline: endurance links trust, devotion, and later withdrawal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that endurance is the public continuation of the prior devotional chain and the prerequisite before beautiful withdrawal.
topics.reason: The local clause order places the endurance command before the withdrawal command, while the cited beautiful-patience parallels (12:18; 12:83; 70:5) support the ethical continuity.

words.gloss_range: preposition that turns the following speech clause into pressure borne under patience
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the load-frame of the first command. It governs {{ar:مَا يَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:mā yaqūlūna}}), so endurance is placed over an ongoing speech clause rather than over a static object. The preposition keeps a spatial pressure image: speech is something borne, not an equal conversational partner. Its long final vowel gives recitational weight to the exact turn where speech becomes something carried.

topics.headline: speech clause becomes borne pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes their speech a pressure placed under endurance before the speakers become the object of withdrawal.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as the prepositional complement of {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) under the command.

topics.headline: weighted prepositional turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition receive weight at the point where hostile speech is converted into something borne.
topics.reason: The orthographic and recitational form supports a lengthened landing on the preposition.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun for what or whatever they say, withholding a direct quotation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: over or upon, framing the speech as borne pressure
what or whatever they keep saying

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the opponents' words present without preserving them as a quotation. Governed by {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), it opens the relative clause {{ar:مَا يَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:mā yaqūlūna}}), so the command covers what they say and whatever they say. Its openness lets patience cover the verbal event without letting one hostile phrase become the ayah's center.

topics.headline: open relative suppresses quotation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hostile speech is generalized and endured without being granted the permanence of a direct quote.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as a relative pronoun governed by {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), with the following verb supplying the relative clause.

topics.headline: content and speech-event remain close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the pronoun covering both the hostile content and the ongoing act of saying, while local grammar keeps it as the relative object of the preposition.
topics.reason: The surface permits pressure toward the speech-event, but attachment evidence keeps {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as the governed relative complement.

words.gloss_range: ongoing plural saying whose exact quote is withheld; intelligible speech-production, not necessarily a morphologically named fabrication
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speaking, speech-production, quoted statements, attribution, disputation, and fabricated saying in derived branches; local Form I imperfect selects ongoing saying

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: withdraw from them with a named severance

words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:yaqūlūna}}) makes the provocation ongoing and plural while leaving the speakers unnamed. Because {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) absorbs the content, the speech is recognized as meaningful saying but not stabilized as a quote. The {{ar:ق و ل}} ({{tr:q-w-l}}) family can name attribution, reciprocal dispute, or forged speech, but the local Form I imperfect stays generic: restraint is commanded before the speech is morphologically labeled fabrication, even against the forged-speech pole (69:44). Inside the surah, this human saying contrasts with the heavy divine word (73:5) and the upright night speech (73:6), then becomes the occasion for bounded withdrawal.

topics.headline: imperfect plural makes speech recurring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command responds to a continuing verbal environment from an unnamed plural group, not to a single closed insult.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:يَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:yaqūlūna}}) as a Form I imperfect, third masculine plural verb with an unexpressed plural subject.

topics.headline: speech event without durable quotation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hostile speech acknowledged without letting the hostile wording become the ayah's quoted center.
topics.reason: The relative construction places the saying under {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), so the object is covered without an explicit quote.

topics.headline: generic saying avoids derived accusation frames
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that restraint does not wait for the speech to be branded as forged, attributed, or reciprocal disputation; the local form keeps it as saying.
topics.reason: Dictionary branches support attribution, disputation, and fabricated saying elsewhere, including fabricated-speech language (69:44), but QAC identifies this local word as Form I imperfect.

topics.headline: human saying contrasts with heavier speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local speech thread in which human hostile saying is set against the surah's weightier speech field before withdrawal is ordered.
topics.reason: The cited same-surah parallels connect this saying with the heavy word (73:5) and upright night speech (73:6), while local order links it to subsequent withdrawal.

words.gloss_range: second coordinator adding the withdrawal command to the endurance command
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds {{ar:ٱهْجُرْهُمْ}} ({{tr:uhjurhum}}) to {{ar:ٱصْبِرْ}} ({{tr:iṣbir}}) without collapsing the two commands. Patience remains the first response to speech, and withdrawal becomes the paired second act. Its attached, audible entry keeps the second command joined rather than abrupt.

topics.headline: second connector adds withdrawal to patience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a dual response: endure the speech and then disengage, with neither command replacing the other.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second imperative as coordinated with the first command, while local order keeps the clauses distinct.

topics.headline: joined sound of the second imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second command enter as an attached continuation, not as a detached rupture.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector is bound to the following imperative in the surface form.

words.gloss_range: commanded personal withdrawal from them after enduring their speech; not reciprocal boycott, expulsion, or formal migration
words.root_gloss_range: separation, leaving, abandonment, migration in derived forms, estrangement, and foul-speech associations; local Form I with object suffix selects disciplined withdrawal from persons

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: them, the plural object of withdrawal

words.prose: {{ar:ٱهْجُرْهُمْ}} ({{tr:uhjurhum}}) turns from the speech to the speakers: what they say is borne, but they become the object of controlled withdrawal. The {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) suffix makes that object grammatically inseparable from the command. The wider {{ar:ه ج ر}} ({{tr:h-j-r}}) field includes migration, reciprocal estrangement, expulsion, and ugly-speech associations, but this surface selects unilateral personal severance. It comes after endurance, repeats into {{ar:هَجْرًا}} ({{tr:hajran}}) before the final adjective restricts its manner, and anticipates the handoff in the next ayah (73:11), while reversing culpable abandonment of revelation (25:30) into disciplined distance from opponents.

topics.headline: withdrawal targets persons, not the speech itself
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammatical shift: speech is endured through a preposition, while the speakers are directly governed by withdrawal.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the attached {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) suffix as the direct object of the imperative and links it to the unnamed plural speakers.

topics.headline: severance selected, other branches bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a forceful command to separate, while migration, expulsion, reciprocal boycott, and ugly speech remain blocked as the local relation.
topics.reason: The dictionary field contains those branches, but QAC and attachment evidence select Form I transitive withdrawal from a pronominal object.

topics.headline: withdrawal follows endured speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that separation is not the first reflex; it follows the endured speech and is immediately shaped by the following noun and adjective.
topics.reason: Local order places this second imperative after the speech-bearing clause and before the cognate accusative plus adjective.

topics.headline: commanded distance prepares divine handoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees withdrawal as a disciplined handoff toward divine handling (73:11) and as a reversal of culpable abandonment of revelation (25:30).
topics.reason: The cited references connect the local withdrawal command with the following divine-takeover command (73:11) and with abandoned revelation (25:30).

words.gloss_range: cognate verbal noun naming and intensifying the withdrawal so its manner can be qualified
words.root_gloss_range: leaving, severance, abandonment, estrangement, migration-related derivatives, and foul-speech associations; local verbal noun selects the named act of withdrawal
words.prose: {{ar:هَجْرًۭا}} ({{tr:hajran}}) is not decorative repetition. As the cognate verbal noun after {{ar:ٱهْجُرْهُمْ}} ({{tr:uhjurhum}}), it names the act of severance, strengthens it, and creates the grammatical slot where {{ar:جَمِيلًا}} ({{tr:jamīlā}}) can govern its manner. The adjacent verb-noun reprise also makes severance audible before the phrase softens into the qualifier. Its indefiniteness keeps the kind of withdrawal open until the adjective specifies it. The word selects disciplined severance, not migration-place language or foul speech, and the echo with abandoned revelation (25:30) sharpens the contrast between culpable abandonment and commanded distance.

topics.headline: verbal noun intensifies and objectifies withdrawal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the withdrawal is made into a named act that can be strengthened and then morally evaluated.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:هَجْرًا}} ({{tr:hajran}}) as a cognate accusative of the preceding withdrawal command.

topics.headline: indefiniteness opens the act for qualification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits to learn what kind of withdrawal is meant, because the indefinite noun is immediately locked to its qualifier.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as an indefinite accusative verbal noun, and attachment evidence links the following adjective to it.

topics.headline: severance selected against neighboring branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a concrete act of severance, while migration-place language, extended estrangement wording, and foul-speech associations are kept outside the selected sense.
topics.reason: The broader {{ar:ه ج ر}} ({{tr:h-j-r}}) field contains neighboring branches, but local cognate-accusative grammar selects the verbal act of withdrawal.

topics.headline: root echo makes severance inspectable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the repeated withdrawal root as emphatic, while the reference to abandoned revelation (25:30) turns the same field toward disciplined distance.
topics.reason: The local verb-noun repetition is immediate, and the cited reference (25:30) supplies a concrete contrast within the same root field.

words.gloss_range: postposed adjective qualifying the manner of withdrawal as beautiful, gracious, and free of ugly residue
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, graciousness, seemliness, wholeness, and evaluative beautifying in derived branches; local adjective gives withdrawal a stable visible quality
words.prose: {{ar:جَمِيلًۭا}} ({{tr:jamīlā}}) is the final control on the ayah's withdrawal. It agrees with and qualifies {{ar:هَجْرًا}} ({{tr:hajran}}), so beauty belongs to the act of leaving, not to the actor or the opponents. The {{ar:ج م ل}} ({{tr:j-m-l}}) field gives the separation a visible quality of graciousness, wholeness, and freedom from ugliness, while the local adjective keeps that quality as manner rather than a new action. As the last word, it makes beauty the closure criterion; the paired indefinite cadence with {{ar:هَجْرًا}} ({{tr:hajran}}) makes the close sound like one unit, so beauty is the last heard quality. The beautiful-patience formula (12:18; 12:83; 70:5) is extended from enduring pain to leaving well.

topics.headline: beauty modifies the withdrawal itself
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah evaluates the mode of separation, not the moral status of the withdrawer or the opponents.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:جَمِيلًا}} ({{tr:jamīlā}}) as the adjective qualifying the accusative verbal noun {{ar:هَجْرًا}} ({{tr:hajran}}).

topics.headline: beauty constrains severance without canceling it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees withdrawal remain decisive while its visible manner must be gracious, whole, and free of ugly residue.
topics.reason: The broader {{ar:ج م ل}} ({{tr:j-m-l}}) family supports beauty and seemliness, but QAC identifies the local form as a qualitative adjective, not a new beautifying verb.

topics.headline: final word controls the aftertaste
topics.reader_payoff: The reader leaves the ayah with beauty as the last heard criterion, not with rupture as the last impression.
topics.reason: The adjective is the final word of the ayah and shares the accusative indefinite cadence with the noun it qualifies.

topics.headline: beautiful patience extends into beautiful withdrawal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the beauty associated with patience (12:18; 12:83; 70:5) now governs departure as part of one ethic.
topics.reason: The cited parallels attach beauty to patience (12:18; 12:83; 70:5), while local grammar attaches beauty to withdrawal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated imperatives اصبر and اهجر, followed by the cognate accusative هجرا and its adjective جميلا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Incoming speech is met first by an inward brake on reactive impulse and then by an outward relational boundary; جميلا constrains the manner of separation so that the response does not reproduce the ugliness that provoked it.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint from panic supplies the inward brake that precedes any outward response.
Uttered speech supplies the incoming pressure to which both imperatives respond.
Severance and separation supplies the outward boundary enacted after restraint.
Graceful goodness in action makes beauty an ethical constraint on how the boundary is performed.

changed_reading.before: Endure their words and then go away from them.
changed_reading.after: Contain the impulse to retaliate, then establish a real boundary whose visible conduct remains graceful.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ongoing ما يقولون is followed by a doubled هجر construction whose object pronoun points back to the speakers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee exits not only proximity to the speakers but also the circulation and register of their speech. Patience prevents uptake into the hostile exchange, while beautiful separation refuses to answer foul speech in its own idiom.

activation_trace.role: Circulating public talk turns what they keep saying into a discourse stream rather than a single insult.
Self-restraint blocks reactive participation in that circulating talk.
Abandoned foul speech makes the separation a refusal of a debased speech-register as well as of contact.
Graceful goodness supplies the alternative register in which disengagement remains legible.

changed_reading.before: Avoid hostile people after tolerating what they say.
changed_reading.after: Quarantine the hostile discourse: do not ingest, repeat, or mirror its register while separating from its speakers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: اصبر and اهجر are coordinated rather than allowed to cancel one another: endurance remains active while contact is curtailed.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of patience carries surety or standing-with, while هجر establishes separation. Their conjunction permits a boundary that ends direct negotiation without licensing moral abandonment of the people beyond it.

activation_trace.role: Bearing surety or standing with another supplies continuing responsibility on the patience side of the pair.
Mutual verbal negotiation identifies the interaction that can cease without erasing ethical concern.
Severance supplies the genuine contact boundary rather than mere inner detachment.
Beautiful conduct keeps the boundary compatible with residual responsibility.

changed_reading.before: Separation ends both interaction and obligation.
changed_reading.after: End direct exchange while continuing to carry an ethical responsibility that shapes the manner of departure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens by setting, halving, decreasing, and increasing a practice, then closes by acknowledging failed enumeration and commanding what is easy. That arc revises beautiful separation from maximal rupture into a proportioned boundary whose degree and duration can answer capacity without surrendering its ethical form.

activation_trace.role: Severance supplies the action whose extent is recalibrated by the surrounding measures.
Graceful goodness makes right proportion part of the boundary's quality.
Fewness supplies an explicit lower quantity rather than an all-or-nothing command.
The half supplies a measured center from which adjustment proceeds.
Taking away part of a thing supplies authorized downward adjustment.
Increase and growth supplies authorized upward adjustment.
Governance by estimation and consideration turns measurement into a responsive policy rather than bare arithmetic.
Exhaustive counting supplies the capacity limit that the closing relaxation answers.
Ease opening after difficulty supplies the final criterion for sustainable performance.

structural_cues: 73:2-4 expresses the night command as a range with a midpoint and two directions of adjustment.
73:20 explicitly links inability to enumerate with a repeated instruction to perform what is easy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a beginning-to-end policy of measured adjustment; I transfer that policy to the later social imperative and infer that جميلا can include proportionality. A live alternative is that calibration governs recitation alone and does not qualify هجر.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful separation is a complete and fixed withdrawal.
changed_reading.after: Beautiful separation is a real but calibrated boundary, adjustable in extent and duration to preserve both purpose and capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The target's hostile sayings are placed after ordered recitation and reception of a weighty قول. Patience and discourse-separation therefore protect the cadence, gravity, and source of entrusted speech from being reorganized by reactive public talk.

activation_trace.role: Circulating public talk supplies the noisy speech stream from which the response must remain distinct.
Abandoned foul speech makes disengagement a protection of speech-register, not silence for its own sake.
Self-restraint prevents hostile talk from dictating the timing and tone of reply.
Ordered arrangement supplies the disciplined form of the speech entrusted to the addressee.
Uttered قول creates a direct lexical counterpart to what the opponents say.
Precious weight gives the received قول gravity and value that reactive exchange could dissipate.

structural_cues: 73:4-6 places arranged recitation, a heavy قول, and straighter قيل before 73:10's ما يقولون.
The target coordinates patience with departure instead of commanding a counter-saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two speech streams with sharply different ordering and weight; I infer a protective arrow from disengagement to preservation of the entrusted stream. The live alternative is that the earlier قول only explains the burden of patience and is not being contrasted rhetorically with their sayings.

changed_reading.before: The command regulates emotional reaction to insults.
changed_reading.after: The command safeguards a weighty, ordered mode of speech from capture by the opponents' circulating discourse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context gives withdrawal a destination: cutting oneself toward the Lord precedes the focus, and taking a path toward the Lord follows it. The migration branch of هجر turns separation from them into a relocation of attention and allegiance rather than an empty social subtraction.

activation_trace.role: Migration from one abode to another supplies positive relocation within the act of leaving.
Graceful goodness makes the destination-directed relocation ethically ordered.
Cutting and setting apart supplies the prior movement away, explicitly directed إليه.
An extended traversable path supplies the positive route toward the Lord after separation.

structural_cues: The directional phrase إليه in 73:8 precedes the focus, while إلى ربه سبيلا in 73:19 supplies a later destination.
The target itself names the people left but leaves the destination unstated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two Lord-directed movements around the target; I infer that they fill the target's unstated destination and convert هجر into reorientation. A live alternative is that devotional withdrawal and social withdrawal remain separate commands.

changed_reading.before: Leave the speakers by moving away from them.
changed_reading.after: Relocate attention and allegiance away from their speech and onto a traversable Lord-directed path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Taking the Lord as trustee before the focus and the instruction to leave the deniers with the speaker after it make separation an agency handoff. The following respite prevents that handoff from collapsing into immediate vengeance: the addressee relinquishes enforcement while judgment and timing pass elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Legal requital marks the retaliatory path that patience declines to execute personally.
Separation creates the operational space in which agency can be handed off.
Graceful action characterizes relinquishment of enforcement as disciplined rather than impotent.
Handing an affair to another supplies the explicit transfer-of-agency mechanism.
Leaving a thing supplies the post-focus instruction that places the deniers with the divine speaker.
Deliberation without haste gives the transferred affair its own timing rather than immediate retaliation.

structural_cues: 73:9 commands taking a trustee immediately before the focus.
73:11 answers اهجرهم with ذرني والمكذبين and then commands a short respite.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entrustment, separation, leave-Me language, and delay; I infer the arrow from these items to a transfer of adjudicative agency. A live alternative is that trustee language concerns general reliance while 73:11 merely consoles, without defining the mechanics of beautiful separation.

changed_reading.before: Withdraw because no effective response is available.
changed_reading.after: Withdraw as an active handoff: refuse personal enforcement, entrust adjudication elsewhere, and allow its timing to remain delayed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch can picture patience as hard stone or gravelly ground, but the later earth-and-mountain sequence makes even elevated solidity shake, become a heap, and pour away. Context therefore relocates steadfastness from material immobility to self-restraint and beautiful conduct that remain ordered while structures move.

activation_trace.role: Hard stone and gravelly ground supplies the tempting material model of patience as immovability.
Self-restraint supplies the non-material stability that survives the contextual reversal.
Graceful action locates firmness in maintained form and conduct.
Severe agitation destabilizes the ground on which a rigid patience-image would rely.
A solid elevated mass supplies the strongest available emblem of external firmness before its collapse.
Material gathered into a heap supplies the mountain's loss of integrated structure.
Poured-out measure completes the reversal from solid mass to flowing instability.

structural_cues: 73:14 moves in one sentence from earth and repeated mountains to a poured sand-heap.
The focus joins patience to a quality of action rather than to a claim of physical immobility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a stony patience branch and a later destruction of mountain solidity; I infer a corrective arrow from the latter to the former. A live alternative is that the cosmic scene intensifies the need for ordinary firmness rather than revising its material image.

changed_reading.before: Patience means becoming hard and immovable against hostile speech.
changed_reading.after: Patience means maintaining self-command and graceful form even when apparently solid structures become unstable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant mapping of focus قول exposes a branch of rattling, unstable motion, while later رجف exposes both severe shaking and the agitation of reports. Their contact recasts hostile speech as transmissible vibration: patience absorbs the impulse, and beautiful separation prevents retransmission.

activation_trace.role: Rattling and unstable motion gives the focus sayings a form-distant vibration image rather than treating them only as semantic content.
Self-restraint functions as damping that keeps agitation from recruiting the addressee.
Separation breaks the social transmission path of the agitation.
Agitation by alarming reports makes the later shaking root feed back specifically into the focus speech-event.

structural_cues: 73:14 literalizes large-scale shaking after the target's scene of repeated hostile saying.
The focus prescribes no counter-speech, only restraint and separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unstable-motion and report-agitation branches; I infer the causal arrow that repeated hostile talk propagates social motion and that disengagement damps it. The live alternative is that the split قول mapping and the report branch of رجف are both too distant from the surface uses to interact.

changed_reading.before: Do not be upset by the content of their speech.
changed_reading.after: Do not become a relay for the agitation carried by their speech; absorb the impulse and break its transmission path gracefully.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence assigns the messenger the role of sent witness and assigns punitive taking to another agent after disobedience. Beautiful separation protects that role boundary: testimony remains present and truthful, but enforcement is not seized by the witness.

activation_trace.role: Legal requital supplies the enforcement function withheld from the addressee.
Separation prevents witness-bearing from turning into coercive control of its hearers.
Beautiful conduct makes role restraint part of faithful performance.
Messenger and message supplies the commissioned communicative role.
Presence with witnessing specifies that the messenger's continuing relation is testimonial, not punitive.
Taking to account for wrongdoing supplies the punitive role performed by the sentence's other agent.

structural_cues: 73:15 names the messenger a witness over the audience.
73:16 shifts from Pharaoh's disobedience to first-person plural punitive taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive communicative, testimonial, and punitive roles; I infer that 73:10 keeps those roles institutionally distinct. A live alternative is that the Pharaoh sequence is only an analogy of warning and does not retroactively define the addressee's role.

changed_reading.before: Leaving is a pause after failed persuasion.
changed_reading.after: Leaving preserves the messenger as witness rather than enforcer: testimony continues, but coercive accounting belongs to another agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing economy cuts out a good loan now, sends good ahead, and finds it later as recompense. Applied back to the focus, beautiful separation does not erase the claim raised by hostile speech; it declines immediate collection and forwards settlement into a deferred account.

activation_trace.role: Legal requital supplies the claim that is deferred rather than personally collected.
Separation interrupts immediate reciprocal settlement.
Graceful goodness describes the form of value sent forward instead of retaliation.
Cutting out wealth or work for later return supplies the deferred-account mechanism.
Advancing something forward supplies the temporal transfer away from immediate settlement.
Finding and encountering supplies eventual recovery of what was forwarded.
Recompense for work supplies the later settlement that replaces immediate retaliation.

structural_cues: 73:20 orders a good loan, then says that good sent ahead will be found with God as greater recompense.
73:10 itself interrupts the ordinary reciprocity of saying and counter-saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deferred-return economy; I map injury-response onto that economy and infer that restraint forwards rather than cancels settlement. A live alternative is that the closing account concerns only the worshipper's good deeds and should not be applied to claims against opponents.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful separation simply waives response to injury.
changed_reading.after: Beautiful separation suspends immediate collection, answers with good conduct, and leaves the claim in a deferred economy of recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's closing covering and tenderness color the earlier adjective جميلا. Separation can be protective rather than expositional: it stops harmful exchange without making public exposure, humiliation, or lasting injury the aim of departure.

activation_trace.role: Severance supplies the necessary boundary that mercy colors but does not dissolve.
Graceful goodness provides the focus anchor through which covering and tenderness can qualify departure.
False saying or attribution supplies the wrong that need not be answered through retaliatory exposure.
A covering that protects supplies a non-expositional mode for handling wrong.
Mercy and tenderness supplies the affective limit on what separation seeks to do.

structural_cues: The final ayah closes the surah with paired predicates of covering forgiveness and mercy.
The target modifies the manner of هجر rather than weakening the imperative to separate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective covering and tenderness at the close; I infer that these qualities can specify what beautiful departure does not aim at. A live alternative is that the closing predicates address the worshippers' failures only and do not color conduct toward the speakers in 73:10.

changed_reading.before: A beautiful departure is merely polite and non-confrontational.
changed_reading.after: A beautiful departure establishes distance without turning exposure, humiliation, or harm into its purpose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The tether and thick-rope images are form-distant from the surface adjective and appear paradoxical beside severance, but they remain anchored in the doubled هجر, جميلا, and the coordinated patience command. Downstream prose should present this only as an exploratory boundary-image, not as a lexical replacement for graceful separation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus coordinates continued patience with separation and explicitly qualifies the manner of that separation.

activation_trace.role: Binding with a tether supplies a boundary that restricts relation without imagining unbounded rupture.
A thick gathered rope reinforces the image of controlled relational tension.
Standing surety for another keeps ethical attachment live across the controlled distance.

changed_reading.before: Separation cuts every line of relation.
changed_reading.after: Separation can be a tensioned boundary: contact is restricted while ethical attachment remains under control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Making night a mount is a proverbial, branch-distant image, and linking it to daytime swimming creates a cross-domain itinerary. It remains validly anchored in focus جميلا and migration-like هجر while context repeatedly supplies night practice and daytime movement; downstream prose should mark it as imagistic activation rather than a semantic gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final adjective جميلا carries a branch image of mounting the night for travel, while هجر carries movement from one abode to another.

activation_trace.role: Making night a mount for travel turns beautiful departure into one leg of a disciplined itinerary.
Migration between abodes supplies the focus movement that the itinerary image carries.
Practicing an affair at night supplies the temporal terrain that can be mounted.
Running or swimming supplies the contrasting daytime movement within the same itinerary.

changed_reading.before: Departure is a static social withdrawal.
changed_reading.after: Departure is an imagistic change of route: leave the hostile speech-field, mount the night's discipline, and re-enter daytime movement without carrying the quarrel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The digestive transfer from saying to tasting and choking is deliberately cross-domain, and the bitter-medicine patience branch is not the surface sense of اصبر. It remains anchored in ما يقولون, the branch of drawing speech inward, and the speech-abandonment branch of هجر; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for rumination, not a claim about literal ingestion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ما يقولون names incoming speech, while اصبر and اهجر prescribe how it is internally received and then left.

activation_trace.role: Drawing a saying into oneself supplies the internalization or rumination side of the analogy.
Bitter medicinal extract supplies the tempting image of swallowing pain in the name of patience.
Abandoned foul speech supplies the alternative of leaving the toxic register outside rather than incorporating it.
Tasting and taking in food supplies the contextual ingestion mechanism.
A choking obstruction in the throat supplies the cost of what cannot be assimilated.

changed_reading.before: Patience requires swallowing whatever they say without response.
changed_reading.after: Patience need not mean ingesting hostile speech; beautiful separation can interrupt rumination before the speech becomes an internal obstruction.

strongest_changes: Ordered recitation and a weighty قول turn patience and هجر into protection of an entrusted speech-register, not generic stoicism.
Trusteeship before the focus and leave-Me language after it recast beautiful separation as a delayed handoff of adjudicative agency.
The surah's opening measurements and closing ease policy make the boundary capacity-aware rather than maximally ruptural.
The collapse of mountain solidity relocates patience from material hardness to maintained self-command and graceful form.
Messenger, witness, and punitive-taking roles distinguish testimony from enforcement.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled هجر and جميلا supported both a dominant graceful-boundary reading and live directional, tethered, and night-itinerary images. Most unusually, the non-dominant قول-to-قلة mapping joined رجف's report-agitation branch to produce a rumor-damping model without replacing the ordinary speech sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer of measurement and ease from night practice to social separation is coherent but not grammatically explicit.
The later punishment sequence may define an agency handoff, or it may function only as warning after an independently beautiful departure.
The deferred-account and mercy models depend on reading the closing ayah back into conduct toward the hostile speakers.
The tether, night-mount, digestive, and rumor-motion readings are branch-backed but intentionally form-distant and should remain qualified.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Patience restrains panic so separation does not become retaliation.** `ص ب ر` B001 supplies self-restraint from panic; `ه ج ر` B001 supplies severance; `ج م ل` B004 supplies graceful goodness in action. The sequence places restraint before the command to leave, and 73:11 immediately transfers the deniers to divine handling. I infer that self-restraint prevents hostile speech from dictating the form of departure. “Beautiful abandonment” is thus controlled non-retaliatory disengagement.

2. **The command answers circulating speech with a coherent whole action.** `ق و ل` B007 supplies circulating talk or public report, while `ج م ل` B003 supplies the collected, undetailed whole. The plural `ما يقولون` is met not by point-by-point rebuttal but by one integrated act of `هجرًا جميلًا`. I infer that refusing fragmentation by every hostile utterance preserves coherent conduct. The beauty is functional wholeness as well as moral grace.

3. **Separation can be a practiced discipline.** `ه ج ر` B009 supplies habitual refrain or constant practice, while the cognate accusative `هجرًا` intensifies the manner of the command. The repeated night regimen and the later practical obligations show disciplined recurrence. I infer that the departure must be maintained, not performed once in anger. The ayah can therefore describe an enduring boundary practice.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 73:11 immediately reveals that separation is a transfer—“leave Me with” the deniers—rather than abandonment of accountability. 73:15’s deliberately sent witness further shows that beautiful departure coexists with measured public testimony.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Night-trained restraint under social pressure.** **Lexical evidence:** `ص ب ر B001` is self-restraint from panic or blameworthy impulse, and `ق و ل B007` is circulating public talk or report. **Structural cue and role:** the heavy, carefully received saying of 73:5-6 is now set against what "they say" in an unmarked plural. The public-report branch makes the surrounding talk the pressure, while self-restraint preserves the entrusted speech from reactive distortion. **Abductive move:** the two speech settings and the command are supplied; I infer that the earlier night discipline is preparation for this social encounter. **Reading change:** patience is controlled reception of pressure, not mere waiting for it to end.

2. **A speech ecology with unequal weights.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ق و ل B007` supplies circulating talk, while 73:5 activates `ق و ل B001` as the weighty utterance and `ث ق ل B005` as high worth. **Structural cue and role:** the speaker is told to endure the plural sayings rather than answer them in kind, so the two classes of speech are not treated as equivalent. **Abductive move:** their differing transmission, number, and assigned responses are supplied; I infer that weight, not volume, determines which speech governs conduct. **Reading change:** `ما يقولون` becomes ambient circulation around a more consequential received saying.

3. **Severance whose modifier blocks verbal ugliness.** **Lexical evidence:** `ه ج ر B001` is severance and distancing, but `ه ج ر B003` is abandoned foul speech; `ج م ل B004` is beauty or graceful goodness in action. **Structural cue and role:** the verb and cognate noun intensify the separation, while `جميلا` constrains its manner. The beauty branch actively excludes the root's foul-speech route and makes ethical form part of the command. **Abductive move:** repetition and adjective are explicit; I infer that a separation enacted through abuse would contradict its modifier. **Reading change:** `هجرا جميلا` is firm distance that refuses both continued entanglement and ugly retaliation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 73:11's `ذرني` completed the logic of beautiful separation as a handoff rather than abandonment. 73:15 then corrected any reading in which distance ends engagement: the messenger remains present as a witness even when retaliation is refused.

baseline.text: Onların söylediklerine sabret ve onlardan güzelce uzaklaş.

findings.text: Sabır, dolaşan düşmanca sözlerin baskısını denetimli biçimde karşılayıp kişinin kendi sözünü tepkisel bozulmadan korumasıdır.
Çevrede çokça dolaşan sözlerin değil, daha önce emanet edilen ağır sözün davranışı yönetmesi gerektiği ortaya çıkar.
Güzelce uzaklaşma, ayrılığı çirkin ve incitici sözle gerçekleştirme yolunu bizzat dışlar.
Her söze ayrı ayrı sürüklenmek yerine tek ve tutarlı bir uzaklaşma davranışı göstermek, güzelliğe bütünlük boyutu ekler.
Uzaklaşmanın yinelenen bir sakınma alışkanlığı olması, onu bir anlık öfke tepkisi değil, sürdürülen bir sınır hâline getirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Cutting one relation does not leave a vacuum; the released affair is redirected toward an endpoint and entrusted to a keeper.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Separation extends from severance and migration to a self-sufficient palm offshoot, while reliance is tested against failed mutual delegation and lagging dependence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Severance directed toward an endpoint
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A participant cuts loose from competing attachments and directs the separation toward a terminal relation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cutting and distinguishing one thing from another (`quranic:root_000082:B001/m01`); abstention from marital attachment (`quranic:root_000082:B003/m01`); a palm offshoot separated from its mother (`quranic:root_000082:B004/m01`); separation and bodily, verbal, or inward departure (`quranic:root_001578:B001/m01`); exile and removal from one’s place (`quranic:root_001077:B007/m01`); reaching an endpoint (`quranic:root_000076:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 73:8 `تَبَتَّلْ/تَبْتِيلًا`; 73:9 `ٱلْمَغْرِبِ`; 73:10 `ٱهْجُرْهُمْ/هَجْرًا`; surface anchor unavailable for `quranic:root_000076:B001` because `ء ل ي` is missing from root coverage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is not mere isolation. Like an offshoot that has become self-standing, separation removes dependency so movement can terminate in a newly exclusive attachment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: holding the self back from panic or reaction (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); leaving and distancing without continued exchange (`quranic:root_001578:B001/m01`); beauty in conduct and action (`quranic:root_000260:B004/m01`); fairness and equal dealing (`quranic:root_001511:B003/m01`); good reputation produced by conduct (`quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Departure is shaped as an ethical performance rather than a rupture driven by rage. Restraint, equitable dealing, and beauty specify the manner in which the relation is ended and the kind of public memory it leaves.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: What is no longer personally grasped is delegated to a sovereign caretaker who can preserve and discharge it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: taking something as one’s own (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); handing an affair to another (`quranic:root_001681:B001/m01`); reliance (`quranic:root_001681:B002/m01`); a sufficient guardian and guarantor (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`); ownership and sovereignty (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); repair, nurture, and completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); surety and accompanying responsibility (`quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: “Taking a guardian” reverses ordinary possession: the human act of taking installs another as the true holder of the affair. Sovereignty is joined to nurture and surety, distinguishing reliable guardianship from dependence that merely abandons responsibility.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Speech From Inward Form to Public Circulation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A sign passes through inward conception, articulation, social circulation, and durable naming.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech can become rumor, false attribution, delirium, doctrine, definition, reputation, or a document of right, so verbal pressure is also pressure over social reality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: From inner saying to articulated sign
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An inwardly held representation is externalized by the tongue and made to indicate or define an object.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: an unspoken saying in the self (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); the tongue as speech instrument (`quranic:root_001272:B002/m01`); a thing’s signifying “saying” (`quranic:root_001272:B014/m01`); a defining formulation (`quranic:root_001272:B016/m01`); inward recollection (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); verbal mention (`quranic:root_000516:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Saying begins before sound and ends beyond it. Inward representation becomes tongue-borne wording, then functions as indication and definition, giving the commands to remember and recite a full cognitive-discursive depth.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rumor, fabrication, and verbal injury
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speech detaches from verified reality, circulates among people, and wounds through false attribution or obscenity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: habitual profuse talk (`quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`); saying what did not occur or attributing it falsely (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); circulating public talk (`quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`); negotiation and verbal exchange (`quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`); obscene or injurious speech (`quranic:root_001578:B003/m01`); unintended delirious speech (`quranic:root_001578:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The opponents’ saying opens onto a whole circulation ecology: repetition, bargaining, false imputation, and abusive speech. Delirium marks the limiting case in which words continue while accountable intention has collapsed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Speech From Inward Form to Public Circulation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A sign passes through inward conception, articulation, social circulation, and durable naming.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech can become rumor, false attribution, delirium, doctrine, definition, reputation, or a document of right, so verbal pressure is also pressure over social reality.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Appropriating a saying as conviction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Received speech is taken inward, weighed as a supposition, and either adopted as doctrine or held with sincere concern.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: taking a saying inward as one’s own (`quranic:root_001272:B006/m01`); supposition and opinion (`quranic:root_001272:B011/m01`); belief or doctrine (`quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`); sincere concern expressed in speech (`quranic:root_001272:B015/m01`); receiving and learning words (`quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: This scene separates hearing from assent. A saying can be received, entertained as an opinion, and appropriated as a settled conviction; sincere concern marks a morally different mode of inward uptake from rumor or fabrication.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Time is perceived as movement across a bounded expanse, whether by sun, traveler, swimmer, mount, or caravan.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The long daytime “swim” becomes both livelihood-roaming and a transport scene in which the night itself is ridden as a camel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Riding through night and roaming by day
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler mounts the night, moves with companions, and uses the day’s breadth for livelihood.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: nighttime travel (`quranic:root_001392:B002/m01`); taking the night as a camel for continuous travel (`quranic:root_000260:B008/m01`); a camel herd (`quranic:root_000260:B001/m01`); swimming, running, or extended motion (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); free movement for livelihood (`quranic:root_000666:B005/m01`); a traveling company (`quranic:root_000644:B009/m01`); travel provisions (`quranic:root_000657:B005/m01`); distance and estrangement (`quranic:root_001077:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The day-night contrast becomes a travel economy. Night is a mount to be ridden with endurance; day is open roaming for livelihood, supplied by provisions and exposed to distance from home.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Time is perceived as movement across a bounded expanse, whether by sun, traveler, swimmer, mount, or caravan.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The long daytime “swim” becomes both livelihood-roaming and a transport scene in which the night itself is ridden as a camel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sky movement and layered weather
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: High, layered clouds gather, persist, and move above the day-night route.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sky, cloud, and what rises overhead (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); layered rain cloud (`quranic:root_000532:B008/m01`); stacked white cloud (`quranic:root_000840:B010/m01`); cloud named `النَّاهُور` (`quranic:root_001559:B008/m01`); rising and elevation (`quranic:root_001502:B001/m01`); a high object visible at distance (`quranic:root_000745:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Elevation links the night’s rising to meteorological formation. Persisting cloud layers supply a visible model of accumulation above the horizontal journey, turning temporal endurance into a sky-borne structure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water becomes usable through a linked system of source, channel, lifting vessel, receiving basin, and controlled flow.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The vocabulary assembles an almost complete hydraulic installation beneath passages usually read through worship, speech, and cosmic direction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A loaded vessel under a captain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Cargo and rigging are carried over water while a captain directs the vessel beneath waves and sky.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: thick ship rope (`quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`); a captain of sailors (`quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`); wave crest or high back (`quranic:root_001077:B009/m01`); swimming through water (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); freight and load (`quranic:root_000644:B001/m01`); upright mechanical part (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); sky overhead (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rope, freight, upright gear, wave, and captain complete a maritime role map. The lexical captain extends divine guardianship into skilled navigation of a loaded vessel.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Proportion, Bodily Beauty, and Ethical Grace
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Beauty arises when distinct parts are properly spaced, balanced, and coordinated into a gracious whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: “Beautiful abandonment” is reinforced by a concrete aesthetics of even teeth, balanced facial features, distinct limbs, color, and stature.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Grace as proportionate conduct
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Ethical action is held to a balanced measure, neither retaliatory excess nor degrading retreat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: beauty in action (`quranic:root_000260:B004/m01`); fairness and equal dealing (`quranic:root_001511:B003/m01`); self-restraint (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); straightness and moderation (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); departure from a relation (`quranic:root_001578:B001/m01`); surpassing the ordinary limit in beauty (`quranic:root_001578:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The beautiful act is a proportioned response. Straightness and fairness prevent withdrawal from becoming either cowardice or aggression, while the lexical “surpassing beauty” intensifies the demanded quality of the departure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Concentration, Preservation, and Stored Food
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Perishable material is reduced, thickened, dried, melted, mixed, and stored to make concentrated sustenance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Reducing the night by half resonates with reducing drink by half, while patience and horizon heat open onto preserved travel food.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reducing and concentrating food
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Liquids and fats are heated, dried, or combined until they become concentrated and durable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: drink cooked down by half (`quranic:root_001511:B008/m01`); thick syrup or residue used to preserve and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`); melted fat (`quranic:root_000260:B005/m01`); sun-dried meat (`quranic:root_000790:B002/m01`); a date-milk-ghee preparation (`quranic:root_001659:B007/m01`); wine or pressed date drink (`quranic:root_001077:B016/m01`); bitter medicinal aloe (`quranic:root_000840:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Half-reduction, thickening, melting, sun-drying, and mixing are distinct preservation operations in one kitchen process. The bitter aloe adds medicinal concentration, giving patient endurance a literal taste.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Concentration, Preservation, and Stored Food
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Perishable material is reduced, thickened, dried, melted, mixed, and stored to make concentrated sustenance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Reducing the night by half resonates with reducing drink by half, while patience and horizon heat open onto preserved travel food.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Packing and serving durable stores
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Concentrated provisions are packed into vessels or sacks and set out as a stored food supply.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: travel stores (`quranic:root_000657:B005/m01`); a large storage jar (`quranic:root_001251:B003/m01`); food heaped or laid on a table (`quranic:root_000840:B011/m01`); a food sack and prepared mixture (`quranic:root_001659:B007/m01`); thickened food and repaired skins (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`); taking the whole load (`quranic:root_000644:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Processing terminates in storage and service. Jar, sack, preserved skin, heap, and complete load make a compact provisioning scene suited to the traveler activated elsewhere in P1.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Force organizes bodies by fastening them, bringing them into direct contest, or deliberately releasing them from engagement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The restrained response at 73:10 stands against a dense latent combat frame of hobbling, wrestling grips, crushing pressure, reprisal, and feud.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fastening and immobilizing a body
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rope and fastening points bind an animal or person and restrict movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tying and securing a bond (`quranic:root_000782:B001/m01`); a hobble joining limb to limb (`quranic:root_001578:B007/m01`); a long tether (`quranic:root_000959:B002/m01`); thick rope (`quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`); a gripping handle (`quranic:root_000018:B012/m01`); a stopper sealing an opening (`quranic:root_000840:B018/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene moves from rope to tether, hobble, handle, and stopper, each restricting a different degree of freedom. It supplies a concrete mechanics of restraint beneath the ethical command to restrain the self.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Force organizes bodies by fastening them, bringing them into direct contest, or deliberately releasing them from engagement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The restrained response at 73:10 stands against a dense latent combat frame of hobbling, wrestling grips, crushing pressure, reprisal, and feud.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Grappling, crushing, and feud
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Opponents close distance, seize one another, press violently, and perpetuate retaliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wrestling grip (`quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`); resistance and close contest (`quranic:root_001273:B014/m01`); a combat charge (`quranic:root_000782:B003/m01`); crushing seizure (`quranic:root_001659:B003/m01`); captive execution (`quranic:root_000840:B002/m01`); retaliatory killing (`quranic:root_000840:B012/m01`); blood feud (`quranic:root_000959:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Grip, resistance, charge, and pressure form one close-combat sequence, while execution and feud extend its outcome through time. P1’s beautiful withdrawal becomes a refusal to enter precisely this self-renewing mechanism.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Acute Bodily Seizure and Sensory Failure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Pressure becomes pathology when it takes hold of the body, distorts perception, and produces tremor, pain, or collapse.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The bodily cost of “heaviness” is distributed across ear, eye, face, limbs, and involuntary movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tremor, pain, and burdened movement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fear or anger produces shaking while pain and heaviness obstruct upright movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a tremor from fear or anger (`quranic:root_001251:B005/m01`); pain fixed in an organ (`quranic:root_001273:B019/m01`); bodily heaviness and torpor (`quranic:root_000202:B006/m01`); severe pain or disease (`quranic:root_001077:B017/m01`); an ordeal with no exit (`quranic:root_000840:B006/m01`); harsh stony ground (`quranic:root_000840:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Tremor and localized pain destabilize the standing body, while torpor and rough ground obstruct recovery of gait. The resulting clinical scene gives bodily specificity to endurance under a severe burden.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı, kişinin sarsıntı ve yakınma karşısında kendini tutması, aklın ve doğru sayılan davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kalması olarak kurar. Bu yüzden ruhsal dayanma ile zorla alıkoyma, öldürme, güvence verme ve somut nesne adları birbirinden ayrılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal içsel özdenetim ve dayanıklılıkla sınırlıdır; dışarıdan zorla tutma ya da özel kalıp anlamları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca genel özdenetim ve dayanma çekirdeğini verir, kalıba bağlı anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Sarsıntı, sıkıntı ya da istenmeyen bir durum karşısında kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyması ve doğru bildiği tutumu kararlılıkla sürdürmesidir.

facets.statement: Kişi, sarsıntı ve yakınma dürtüsüne karşı kendini tutar.
Bu kendini tutma, aklın ve doğru davranışın gerektirdiği çizgide kararlı kalmayı içerir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar anlamı sarsıntının karşıtı olan, kişinin kendini taşkın tepkiden alıkoyup gereken tutumda kalmasını sağlayan bir özdenetim olarak birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçsel tepkiyi denetleyip doğru görülen tutumu sürdürme çekirdeğinin tamamı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem kendini tutmayı hem de güçlük karşısında kararlı kalmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıkıntı veya yıkım karşısında taşkın tepki vermeden dirençli kalmayı anlatan bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Güçlük karşısında sağlam ve denetimli kalma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Aklın ya da doğru davranışın gerektirdiği her durumda kendini tutma kapsamını daraltır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصبر بوصفه حبس النفس وثباتها على ما يقتضيه العقل والشرع، وضده الجزع والجبن والضجر بحسب الموضع.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس قتل الصبر ولا يمين الصبر ولا الكفالة ولا أسماء النبات والحجارة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الصبر نقيض الجزع (ayn;jamhara;tahdhib)؛ الصبر حبس النفس عن الجزع (sihah)؛ صبرت نفسي أي حبستها (maqayis;tahdhib)؛ حبس النفس على ما يقتضيه العقل والشرع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ortak çekirdeği dışarıdan uygulanan zorlama ve alıkoyma olarak verir; bunun ölüm gerçekleşene kadar tutma ve yönetici önünde ant içmeye zorlama biçimleri vardır. Bu çerçeve içsel dayanma anlamından ve ödeşme cezasının bağımsız hukuki amacından ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal zorlayıcı alıkoymayı, öldürülmek üzere tutmayı ve yönetici önünde ant içmeye zorlamayı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf karma çıplak olmayan daldır; genel zorla tutma ile öldürme ve ant içirme kalıpları ayrı yüzlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir canlıyı kaçamayacağı biçimde zorla tutmak; özel kullanımlarda onu öldürülene kadar bağlı bırakmak ya da yetkili önünde ant içmeye zorlamaktır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da canlı dışarıdan uygulanan güçle alıkonur ve çıkışı engellenir.
Öldürme kullanımında canlı, ölüm gerçekleşene kadar bağlı ya da tutulmuş durumda bırakılır.
Ant içme kullanımında kişi, yetkili makam önünde ağır bir ant vermeye zorlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar zorla alıkoyma çekirdeğini, öldürülmek üzere tutulan canlıyı ve yetkili önünde ant içmeye mecbur bırakılan kişiyi kapsayacak biçimde sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel zorlama çekirdeği ile ölüm ve ant bağlamındaki özel gerçekleşmeleri birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Dış güçle tutmayı ve kişinin serbestçe çıkamamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın ya da başka bir canlının ölüm gerçekleşene kadar kaçamayacağı biçimde tutulduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorla tutma ile ölüm sonucuna yönelen özel süreci korur.
error_profile.loses: Ant içmeye zorlama kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetkili önünde kişinin ant verene kadar alıkonduğu ya da baskı gördüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorlama ve ant verme katılımcılarını korur.
error_profile.loses: Öldürülmek üzere tutma kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalın çekirdeği, bir suçun karşılığı olarak öldürme yetkisinin uygulanmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yetki, ölüm ve zor kullanma senaryosunda yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal öldürme öncesindeki bağlı tutma biçimini adlandırır; komşu dal ise önceki bir öldürmeye karşılık verilen hukuki öldürme işlemini adlandırır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد الثبات على المصيبة، ولا الكفالة، ولا القصاص بوصفه إقادا مستقلا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المصبورة المحبوسة على الموت (maqayis;sihah)؛ الصبر نصب الإنسان للقتل (ayn;tahdhib)؛ صبرت يمينه أي حلفته (ayn;maqayis;tahdhib)؛ قتل صبر ويمين صبر (sihah;tahdhib)؛ الصبر الإكراه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana anlamı bir başkası için maddi yükü üstlenen güvence verici kişidir. Topluluğun işlerinde onunla birlikte bulunan kişi kullanımı bununla ilişkili olsa da aynı hukuki yükümlülüğü zorunlu olarak taşımaz; bu nedenle ana anlamdan bağımlı bir uzantı olarak ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Güvence verip yük üstlenme çekirdektir; topluluğun işlerine eşlik eden kişi bununla eşitlenmeyen ilişkili bir kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım güvence verme çekirdeğini kurar ve topluluğa eşlik etme kullanımını bağımlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkasının yükümlülüğünü yerine getireceğine güvence vererek doğabilecek yükü üstlenen kişidir. Topluluğun işlerinde onun yanında duran kişi için de ilişkili biçimde kullanılır.

facets.statement: Kişi, bir başkasının yükümlülüğü için güvence verir ve doğabilecek maddi yükü üstlenir.
İlişkili kullanım, bir topluluğun işlerinde onunla birlikte bulunan kişiyi belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir başkası için güvence verip yük üstlenen kişiyi merkeze alır; ayrıca topluluğun işlerinde yanında bulunan kişiyi ilişkili bir kullanım olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir başkasının borç ya da yükümlülüğünü üstlenme çekirdeği için kullanılır; eşlik eden kişi uzantısını tek başına karşılamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasının yükümlülüğüne güvence verme ve yükü üstlenme çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Topluluğun işlerinde onun yanında bulunan kişi uzantısını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hukuki güvence vermekten çok topluluğun işlerine sürekli katılan kişiyi anlatan ilişkili kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Toplulukla birlikte bulunma ve onun işleriyle ilgilenme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Maddi yükümlülüğe güvence verme çekirdeğini içermez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصبير بمعنى الكفيل، وصبرت بفلان إذا كفلت به، وما قرب منه من صبير القوم الذي يكون معهم في أمورهم.
